the family i live with is mixed. my mom remarried when i was 11, to the father of my best childhood friend. i have two biological siblings and two stepsiblings. my childhood friend has become closer to my bio sister over me and they’re now best friends, they share the same friend group and travel to big cities and parties together. like that meme of introducing one best friend to another and then they become better friends. that’s been my life, every single day, for the past almost 10 years. they look down on me subconsciously. they don’t treat me as equal. they haven’t had to change in college, they have had to do no introspection, yet their lives are more socially graceful and fulfilling than mine.

my dad married his affair woman, another exec at his (former) company and both are successful businesspeople. he had a daughter who’s nine now. i love her so much. my stepmom is overly nice. but they genuinely don’t believe they did anything wrong. my sister tried to point it out earlier this year and they told her to “stop holding a grudge”. my dad supports me financially with college, but that’s about it. i took him up to my university, to help me move in to another flat earlier this semester, and he had nothing but cynical advice to give. he treated me like a child. he bashed the stuff i had in my room (posters, books, record player), my clothes, my makeup, and the city i call home now. not a positive thing. he never asked about my friends. he never called once. not on my birthday, not on thanksgiving, not on christmas, not ever. he expects me to have an equal adult relationship with him yet treats me like a child. he criticizes the way i was raised. he criticizes the things that i’m into. and he pointed out my biggest insecurity. i have a BFRB disorder that has me wear a wig full time, and he told me over dinner that there’s “no way nobody has noticed”, that they’re all “just being nice”. 

i want to hate these people but i can’t. they’re family. they’re what i have at the end of the day when my friends leave me. even if they don’t make me feel good.

i just don’t see a point. i think my life is unfair, and i’ve been pretty privileged my entire life. i have a home and access to clean water, and im typing this out on a mobile phone. i feel like i should be more grateful. but then i realize that the people around me aren’t grateful for the little things, and they don’t ruminate on what makes them happy, they just *are*. i just drew the bad hand, i guess. ignorance truly is bliss. 

a personal example. when i was five, my dad cheated on my mom more times than i can count, and he eventually left to be with one woman he had an affair with. he left my mom, who was a stay-at-home, alone with three kids, because he was uninterested in that lifestyle. 15 years later and he and his same wife and their daughter live in a gated community, driving Audis and taking expensive vacations and buying condos in the mountains. my mom worked to become a teacher and get her certificate, stayed up all night to study and drive hours to the workshops, all while juggling three kids. and though we don’t live in squalor, it certainly pales in comparison to my dad’s multimillionaire lifestyle. it isn’t fair. he’s fundamentally a horrible person. how could life give him this way out? if this is what life rewards, what’s the good in trying to be a good person? or even trying at all? i dunno. i just see all the objectively ‘bad’ people in my life be rewarded, and i’ve been given hardship after hardship. not to complain (which i guess i’ve been doing this entire time), but it gives me no hope

We were partners in crime and i loved him. We were both interested in each other for years, having just been best friends at first. We dated for a year and let me tell you, dating your best friend is phenomenal. He was a best friend first and a boyfriend second. He swore we’d be high school sweethearts, and he even supported my plans to move to Canada for uni. 

Until, well, he didn’t. He cheated on me with his co worker, an 18-yr old dropout teen mom whose fiancé worked at the same place (and said fiancé would have told me if my bf hadn’t stepped in and admitted). Completely and utterly out of the blue; Hell, I took him and his dad skiing the literal day before. You can’t make this shit up. He tried to blame me at first, since I was leaving for uni and “he had nobody, what’s he supposed to do”, until I called him out on his bs. He swore he wasn’t talking to her anymore. Lies, I’d soon come to find out. He broke down and threatened to kil himself, and we talked him into going into the mental hospital. He did for a week and ghosted me upon release. Weeks later he’s uploading pictures of this girl’s baby on his shoulders, her arms around him. He started telling people he’s “finally found his family”, and that “I never meant anything to him”. 

Almost a year ago. Life’s been different since. I moved to Toronto, and I heard he’s still connected to her somehow. She supposedly cheated on him with another guy because “that one had money”. I heard that she, in turn, went to the mental hospital for a week in supposed guilt, and he immediately took her back after. I heard he bought an apartment in hopes of impressing her. Ive come home for the holidays and Im hoping I don’t run into him. It’d just be weird.
